name: comp-47
title: Card Number Input
blurb: Credit card number input with card icon.
description: A card number input with a credit card icon on the left. Built with react-payment-inputs library which handles validation and formatting.
use_when: Payment forms where automatic card validation and formatting are needed.
avoid_when: You need a custom card number handler or want to avoid the library dependency.
a11y: Label linked to input. Card icon marked aria-hidden. Peer disabled state supported.
